title: Todo priorities and sorting
prompt: Add priorities to the todo module in src/todo.ts: `addTodo(list, title, priority?)` where priority is "low" | "normal" | "high" (default "normal"), and a new exported function `sortByPriority(list)` that returns a NEW array ordered high > normal > low, keeping the original order within the same priority, with completed todos always at the end. Write tests for the new behaviour.
verify: bun test src && grep -rl --include='*.test.ts' -e 'sortByPriority' src | grep -v bench_hidden | grep -q .
